stories.title: Xi-Trump summit drew Chinese CEOs. So why couldn’t they get a seat at the table?

en.title: Xi-Trump summit drew Chinese CEOs. So why couldn't they get a seat at the table?
en.summary: Chinese business leaders traveled to Washington for a state dinner honoring Xi Jinping but were ultimately excluded from the event after weeks of negotiations between the US and China.

stories.title: Man dragged to death by New York subway train after bag gets caught in door

en.title: Man dragged to death by New York subway train after bag gets caught in door
en.summary: A 57-year-old man in Brooklyn died when his shopping bag became caught in subway train doors, pulling him onto the tracks where he was struck by the departing train.

stories.title: America’s foreign policy of coercion must end

en.title: America's foreign policy of coercion must end
en.summary: The article discusses US President Trump's threat to impose tariffs on Europe and halt trade if the EU grants Canada associate membership status.

stories.title: PM Burnham vows big shake-up for UK in high-risk political speech

en.title: PM Burnham vows big shake-up for UK in high-risk political speech
en.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham outlined plans to reform the electoral system, reset European relations, and implement a new social contract while acknowledging economic constraints pose political risks.

stories.title: Trump rejects calls to work with China on AI safety despite Xi summit progress

en.title: Trump rejects calls to work with China on AI safety despite Xi summit progress
en.summary: US President Trump stated he does not want to cooperate with China on artificial intelligence safety, citing concerns that collaboration could diminish American technological advantage. He announced a voluntary agreement from major US tech companies addressing AI risks.

stories.title: China expands overseas military presence with new Laos air force centre

en.title: China expands overseas military presence with new Laos air force centre
en.summary: China established a joint air force support and training facility in Laos at Ban Keun Airport, operated by both countries to assist Laotian pilot training. The facility includes a support centre and friendship aviation academy.

stories.title: Mystery over UK airbase scare as police find petrol, not explosives

en.title: Mystery over UK airbase scare as police find petrol, not explosives
en.summary: Police investigating a suspected bomb threat at Royal Air Force Fairford in England found petrol rather than explosives in seized vehicles. The incident prompted evacuation of a nearby village and a major incident declaration.

stories.title: 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home

en.title: 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home
en.summary: Spain's government proposed housing crisis measures including an eviction ban through 2030 after an elderly woman's forced removal triggered public protests. The woman has accepted an offer to return to her home.

stories.title: Eiffel Tower chief out over removal of women staff for Hindu group’s visit

en.title: Eiffel Tower chief out over removal of women staff for Hindu group's visit
en.summary: The director general of the Eiffel Tower is stepping down at year's end following a controversy in which women staff were removed during a visit by a Hindu religious group. An internal investigation found operational failures in organizing the visit led to the unacceptable removal.

stories.title: Dare to try: A visibly rewarding creative journey into Disney

en.title: Dare to try: A visibly rewarding creative journey into Disney
en.summary: A Creative Advertising and Media Design student at Hong Kong Metropolitan University has developed a passion for creative storytelling inspired by Disney and fictional worlds, which she hopes to pursue as a career.

en.summary: A Tupolev Tu-95 strategic bomber crashed in Russia's Amur Oblast region during a training flight, resulting in six crew members killed and one injured.

en.summary: China has expressed willingness to collaborate with the United States on matters related to a heads-of-state consensus.

stories.title: The Vertex developer hit with HK$770,000 fine over disclosure failures

en.title: The Vertex developer hit with HK$770,000 fine over disclosure failures
en.summary: Twin City Holdings Limited, developer of The Vertex residential project in Cheung Sha Wan, received a HK$770,000 fine for failing to disclose payment terms and financial incentives to buyers, violating residential properties regulations.

stories.title: Hong Kong firms lag mainland China on AI adoption amid legacy-system burden: Accenture

en.title: Hong Kong firms lag mainland China on AI adoption amid legacy-system burden: Accenture
en.summary: Hong Kong businesses are slower than mainland Chinese firms to adopt artificial intelligence, with only 10 percent having integrated generative AI across multiple functions compared to 21 percent on the mainland, due to outdated systems and conservative attitudes.

stories.title: Eunis Chan, Angela Leong sell luxury Hong Kong properties as rate increases loom

en.title: Eunis Chan, Angela Leong sell luxury Hong Kong properties as rate increases loom
en.summary: Model-actress Eunis Chan and billionaire Angela Leong have sold luxury Hong Kong properties amid expectations of rising interest rates. Chan sold a Mid-Levels flat for HK$32.25 million at approximately 130 percent profit.

stories.title: China’s CXMT to favour domestic suppliers in US$5.2b memory-chip capacity push: source

en.title: China's CXMT to favour domestic suppliers in US$5.2b memory-chip capacity push: source
en.summary: Chinese memory chip manufacturer CXMT plans to invest 34.9 billion yuan in expansion, allocating funds across technology research and development and wafer testing facilities while prioritizing domestic suppliers of chipmaking equipment.

stories.title: Why Citi is betting on China’s 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb

en.title: Why Citi is betting on China's 30-year bonds as US Treasury yields climb
en.summary: Citibank analysts have become optimistic about Chinese 30-year government bonds, expecting their yields to decline to around 1.8 percent despite rising US Treasury yields. The bank recommends investors increase their positions in China's long-term sovereign debt based on easing supply pressures and improving market conditions.
